question.text: Which expression gives the values of $x$ that maximize the graph $y=\sin{x}?$ Assume that $n$ is an integer.
question.explanation:
Let's recall the graph of $y=\sin{x}.$

The function has a maximum at $x=\dfrac{\pi}{2},$ and the period of the function is $2\pi.$ Therefore, the maximum values of the function occur at:

\[ x =\dfrac{\pi}{2} + 2n\pi \]

example.title: Identifying Characteristics of the Sine Function

question.text: Which of the following is a value of $x$ that maximizes the graph of $y=\sin{x}?$
question.explanation:
Let's recall the graph of $y=\sin{x}.$

From the graph, we see that the sine function reaches its maximum value when $x=\dfrac\pi 2$ and $-\dfrac{3\pi}{2}.$

From the given options, the correct answer is $x=\dfrac\pi 2.$

question.text: Which of the following plots is the graph of $y = \cos x?$
question.explanation:
Let's recall some of the basic properties of $y=\cos{x}\mathbin{:}$

  • The domain of the function is $x \in (-\infty, \infty ).$

  • The range of the function is $y\in [-1,1].$

  • The period of the function is $2\pi.$

  • Its zeroes occur at $x= \dots ,\pm\dfrac{\pi}{2},\pm\dfrac{3\pi}{2},\dots$

  • Its maximum values occur at $x=0,\pm2\pi, \pm4\pi,\dots$
